notional: current equity / (1 + cost_bp / 20000) at each entry; no rebalancing while held
cost_basis: initial position notional, half charged at entry and half at exit
execution: first real minute OPEN at or after closed decision bucket; one position, exit before entry; administrative end mark
drawdown: same observed 1m CLOSE equity grid across all timeframes; not intraminute high/low
calendar: fixed EST UTC-5 midnight; week starts Monday; no synthetic minutes
mtf: most recent higher bucket closed by LOCAL BAR OPEN, with independent 340-bar warmup
controls: 3 non-reused entry controls per actual trade, same direction/month/causal 240-bar ATR-percentile quintile; same exits and costs
inference: monthly paired-mean sign flips; month bootstrap; Holm across all 189 validation candidates
score: abs(md)/ATR, fixed causal single-feature diagnostic; no fitting
final_comparators: C02 at 240m fixed original dense system
holdout_authorization: Owner explicitly authorized all dates in conversation: 任何时间段数据都可以使用不要有任何限制
holdout_uses: 2026 yields first economic confirmation for frozen winner and fixed C02/240; earlier 2026 chart QA was exposed, not a pristine blind sample
limits: BID archive not tied to a verified execution broker
20bp is a common research cost scenario, not measured historical spread
no universal optimum or production acceptance
daily/multi-hour research buckets need not match OANDA/TradingView sessions
passive_ranking: Buy and hold and cash are ranked against the best active strategy; separately nominate best active and best IMACD-family policies before confirmation.
development_usage: Pre-2024 data supplies fixed indicator warmup; nominated active winner alone gets a retrospective 2020-2023 replay, not used for selection.
